changelog:
# PerchTV 0.1.5

The update prompt now answers the remote, and the screen names itself.

## WHAT WAS FIXED

- The update prompt could not be reached with the remote. Its buttons took focus with no visible change, and the TV itself answered OK behind the prompt. Now every button shows a bright ring when the remote lands on it, and while the prompt is up the remote talks only to the prompt.
- If the update prompt on your current version still will not answer, that is this defect showing itself one last time: install this version once by hand (adb), and every prompt from here on answers the remote.

## WHAT IS NEW

- The screen names itself: PerchTV with its version and build number sits small in the bottom right corner, dimming with the rest of the panel so it never burns in.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. The 0.1.3 and 0.1.4 fixes (sideload recognition, pause-resume) carry forward untouched.
